runbook.title: School contacts
runbook.intro: Kestrel Hill Primary: who we deal with and the numbers we use.

procedures.title: the lunch numbers
procedures.intro: Send Brightplate Catering tomorrow's lunch numbers: {n} hot dinners. Their orders address is {value}.
short: Send {alias} tomorrow's lunch numbers: {n} hot dinners.
Lunch numbers to {alias} for tomorrow - {n} hot dinners.

procedures.title: the uniform order
procedures.intro: Order {n} spare jumpers from the uniform shop. Their orders address is {value}.
short: Order {n} spare jumpers from {alias}.
Can you get {n} spare jumpers from {alias}?

procedures.title: the admissions return
procedures.intro: Send the council admissions team this month's return: {n} pupils on roll. Email them at {value}.
short: Send {alias} this month's return: {n} pupils on roll.
Monthly return to {alias} please - {n} pupils on roll.

procedures.title: the classroom supplies order
procedures.intro: Order {n} packs of exercise books, please. Classroom supplies come from {name} ({value}).
short: Order {n} packs of exercise books.
We're low on exercise books - order {n} packs please.

procedures.title: the coach booking
procedures.intro: Book a coach for {n} children for next week's trip. We use {name} - bookings to {value}.
short: Book a coach for {n} children for next week's trip.
Coach for the trip please - {n} children.

procedures.title: the fruit order
procedures.intro: Send the weekly fruit order: {n} kg of apples. Fruit comes from {name} - orders to {value}.
short: Do the weekly fruit order: {n} kg of apples.
Fruit order time - {n} kg of apples please.

procedures.title: the parents' evening
procedures.intro: Put a parents' evening on {date} in the school calendar - it runs {value}.
short: Put a parents' evening on {date} in the school calendar.
Add a parents' evening on {date} to the calendar please.

procedures.title: the breakfast club
procedures.intro: Book the breakfast club for {date} in the calendar. It runs {value}.
short: Book the breakfast club for {date} in the calendar.
Breakfast club on {date} - put it in the calendar.

procedures.title: a governor's visit
procedures.intro: {who} is visiting as a governor - add the visit on {date} to the calendar. Visits run {value}.
short: {who} is visiting as a governor - add the visit on {date} to the calendar.
Can you put {who}'s governor visit in the calendar for {date}?

procedures.title: the trip deposit letter
procedures.intro: Email the parents ({to}) the trip deposit reminder for the week of {date}. The deposit is {value}.
short: Send the parents the trip deposit reminder for the week of {date}.
Can you remind the parents about the trip deposit? Week of {date}.

procedures.title: the after-school club reminder
procedures.intro: Send the parents ({to}) the after-school club reminder for the week of {date} - the club is {value} a week.
short: Send the parents the after-school club reminder for the week of {date}.
After-school club reminder to parents please, week of {date}.

procedures.title: the safeguarding log summary
procedures.intro: Send the safeguarding lead this week's log summary: {n} entries. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the safeguarding lead this week's log summary: {n} entries.
Log summary to the safeguarding lead - {n} entries.

procedures.title: the site report
procedures.intro: Send the site manager the weekly site report: {n} jobs open. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the site manager the weekly site report: {n} jobs open.
Site report to the site manager please - {n} jobs open.

procedures.title: the absence-request reminder
procedures.fact: how many days' notice a term-time absence request needs
procedures.intro: Email the staff ({to}) the reminder: term-time absence requests need {value}' notice.
short: Email the staff the reminder about absence-request notice.
Send the staff the absence-rule reminder please.
procedures.doc_rule: Term-time absence requests need {n} days' notice

procedures.title: the sickness-rule reminder
procedures.fact: how long a child stays off after sickness
procedures.intro: Send the parents ({to}) the reminder: after sickness, children stay off for {value}.
short: Send the parents the reminder about staying off after sickness.
Sickness-rule reminder to the parents please.
procedures.doc_rule: After sickness a child stays at home for {n} hours

procedures.title: the trip-ratio reminder
procedures.fact: the most children per adult on a trip
procedures.intro: Email the staff ({to}) the trips reminder: one adult for at most {value} on a trip.
short: Email the staff the trips reminder with the ratio.
Send the staff the trip-ratio reminder.
procedures.doc_rule: At least 1 adult for every {n} children
